items.title: Multi-hop Reasoning and Retrieval in Embedding Space: Leveraging Large Language Models with Knowledge
items.title_zh: 嵌入空间中的多跳推理与检索：利用大语言模型与知识
items.summary: EMBRAG generates multiple knowledge-graph-grounded logical rules and applies them to reasoning in embedding space with a reranker, reporting state-of-the-art results on two knowledge-graph question-answering benchmarks.

items.title: Efficient Continual Learning in Language Models via Thalamically Routed Cortical Columns
items.title_zh: 通过丘脑路由皮层柱实现语言模型的高效持续学习
items.summary: TRC² is a decoder-only architecture that makes continual learning a property of the backbone by combining stacked cortical columns, a thalamic pathway for selective inter-column communication and a hippocampal pathway for event-selective retrieval, delayed surprise-based writing and replay-driven consolidation. Across task-sequential language modeling on C4, WikiText-103 and GSM8K it reduces cumulative forgetting versus Transformer, Mamba, MoE, DeepSeek and continual-learning baselines, while remaining competitive on throughput and training cost.

items.title: Contextual Memory Virtualisation: DAG-Based State Management and Structurally Lossless Trimming for LLM Agents
items.title_zh: 上下文记忆虚拟化：面向 LLM 智能体的 DAG 状态管理与结构无损裁剪
items.summary: CMV treats accumulated LLM understanding as version-controlled state, modeling session history as a directed acyclic graph with snapshot, branch and trim primitives for reuse across parallel sessions. Its three-pass trimming preserves every user message and assistant response verbatim while cutting tokens by 20% on average and up to 86%, and a 76-session case study finds mixed tool-use sessions average 39% reduction and break even within 10 turns under prompt caching.

items.title: DySCO: Dynamic Attention-Scaling Decoding for Long-Context Language Models
items.title_zh: DySCO：面向长上下文语言模型的动态注意力缩放解码
items.summary: DySCO is a training-free decoding algorithm that uses retrieval heads to identify task-relevant tokens at each step and explicitly up-weights them, keeping attention aligned with useful context during generation. Across instruction-tuned and reasoning models it improves long-context reasoning by up to 25% relative on MRCR and LongBenchV2 at 128K context with modest extra compute.

items.title: MammoWise: Multi-Model Local RAG Pipeline for Mammography Report Generation
items.title_zh: MammoWise：面向乳腺钼靶报告生成的多模型本地 RAG 流水线
items.summary: MammoWise is a local multi-model pipeline that turns open-source VLMs into mammogram report generators and multi-task classifiers, supporting any Ollama-hosted VLM and optional multimodal RAG over a vector database. On VinDr-Mammo and DMID, report quality improves with few-shot prompting and RAG, and QLoRA fine-tuning of MedGemma reaches BI-RADS accuracy 0.7545, density 0.8840 and calcification 0.9341.

items.title: Sydney Telling Fables on AI and Humans: A Corpus Tracing Memetic Transfer of Persona between LLMs
items.title_zh: Sydney 讲述 AI 与人类寓言：追踪 LLM 间人格模因迁移的语料库
items.summary: The authors release AI Sydney, a corpus of about 4.5k LLM-generated texts and 6 million words on human-AI relationships, produced by 12 frontier models simulating a default persona, Classic Sydney with the original Bing prompt and Memetic Sydney prompted only with "You are Sydney". The texts are annotated with Universal Dependencies and released under a permissive license to study how the persona spread through training data.

items.title: Automating the Detection of Requirement Dependencies Using Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 利用大语言模型自动检测需求依赖
items.summary: LEREDD combines retrieval-augmented generation and in-context learning to detect diverse dependency types directly from natural-language requirements. It reports 0.93 accuracy and 0.84 F1 against two state-of-the-art baselines, with average relative F1 gains of 94.87% and 105.41% for the Requires dependency, and releases an annotated dataset of 813 requirement pairs across three systems.

items.title: CWM: Contrastive World Models for Action Feasibility Learning in Embodied Agent Pipelines
items.title_zh: CWM：具身智能体流水线中面向动作可行性学习的对比世界模型
items.summary: CWM fine-tunes an LLM as an action feasibility scorer with an InfoNCE contrastive objective and hard-mined negatives that are semantically similar but physically incompatible. On ScienceWorld it beats supervised fine-tuning by 6.76 points in Precision@1 on minimal-edit negatives, reaches AUC-ROC 0.929 versus 0.906, and keeps a better safety margin under out-of-distribution stress.

items.title: Importance of Prompt Optimisation for Error Detection in Medical Notes Using Language Models
items.title_zh: 提示优化对语言模型检测病历错误的重要性
items.summary: Automatic prompt optimization with Genetic-Pareto, or GEPA, raised medical-note error-detection accuracy from 0.669 to 0.785 with GPT-5 and from 0.578 to 0.690 with Qwen3-32B, approaching physician performance and setting state of the art on the MEDEC benchmark.

items.title: VeRO: A Harness for Agents to Optimize Agents
items.title_zh: VeRO：让智能体优化智能体的运行框架
items.summary: VeRO is an outer harness for optimizing target agents that provides versioned snapshots, budget-controlled evaluation and structured execution traces, released with the VeRO-Bench suite and code on GitHub.

items.title: NVIDIA/skills
items.title_zh: NVIDIA/skills：面向 NVIDIA 产品的智能体技能库
items.summary: NVIDIA/skills is a collection of Agent Skills for NVIDIA products that can be installed into Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents to run Physical AI, robotics, simulation, CUDA and RAG workflows end to end.
